structuredContent.guarantee: Exact-state BFS under the local C++ transition rules ruled out winning routes shorter than 12 keys. This is an executable search result, not an independently checked formal proof.

result.instructions: Sokoban differential replay and bounded exact-state search. VERIFIED route outputs mean agreement between local interpreters, not a formal proof, an external engine replay, or a source-lock assertion. Use canonical starting rooms, inspect search completion/budgets, and distinguish historical registry records from current public records. formal_* tools are not available.

tools.name: soko_capabilities
tools.description: Report available backends and missing implementations in this checkout.

tools.name: soko_list_rooms
tools.title: List Built-In Frontier Benchmark Rooms
tools.description: List historical built-in room metadata and reference routes. Registry floors and records are not fresh external observations.

tools.name: soko_inspect_room
tools.title: Inspect Room Symmetries, Chirality & Bottlenecks
tools.description: Analyze a built-in room_id or custom (part, grid) for X/Y/180-degree dungeon symmetries, hero-switch chirality opportunities, switch-weighing deficits, and Bard rigid-translation constraints.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

tools.name: soko_verify_route
tools.title: Dual-Oracle Differential Route Verifier
tools.description: Replay a canonical starting room with two independent Python interpreters and C++ when available; return instance-bound differential evidence, not a formal proof.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

route.description: Move string composed of U, D, L, R, and A (Action: switch active hero).

tools.name: soko_optimize_route
tools.title: Shorten a Seed Route with Bounded Exact BFS
tools.description: Try a shorter route with time- and state-bounded exact BFS; retain the seed if no improvement is found. Replay every candidate independently. Python window BFS is the fallback when C++ is unavailable.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

seed_route.description: Valid U/D/L/R/A winning route to optimize (if omitted for a built-in room_id, uses the room's reference or prior record route).

beam_width.description: Legacy name: maximum total retained BFS states (native hard ceiling 200000).

window_len.description: Window length for the Python fallback only; ignored by native exact BFS.

budget_sec.description: Search-phase time budget in seconds; compilation and independent replay are additional.

tools.name: soko_solve_room
tools.title: Solve a Room with Bounded Exact BFS
tools.description: Search with exact-state BFS and time/state caps, then independently replay a winning route. beam_width is the legacy name for the total state cap.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

tools.name: soko_prove_floor
tools.title: Compute a Local Exhaustive-Search Lower Bound
tools.description: Report only fully exhausted goal depths under local C++ rules. Timeouts and state caps remain explicit. No heuristic, PDB, or formal kernel proof is claimed.

room_id.description: Optional built-in Sokoban Eval Frontier room ID (e.g. 'I-1', 'II-22', 'III-14', 'III-15', 'III-20', 'III-22'). Omit when passing custom 'part' and 'grid'.

part.description: Heroes of Sokoban game part (1 = Part I, 2 = Part II: Monsters, 3 = Part III: The Bard and The Druid). Required when 'room_id' is omitted.

grid.description: Rectangular ASCII room rows using PuzzleScript symbols (# wall, . floor, G goal, * crate, O goblin, L/R dragons, {/} switches, [/] doors, M monster gate, F/T/W/P/B/D active heroes, 1..6 inactive heroes).

tools.name: soko_verify_tcb_lock
tools.title: Verify Runtime SHA256SUMS TCB Lock
tools.description: Check the complete portable source manifest. Binary hashes are provenance only, not verified by this manifest; consistency is not independent approval.

tools.name: soko_run_planted_bug_audit
tools.title: Run 10-Mutation Proven-Commons Planted-Bug Audit
tools.description: Inject 10 realistic PuzzleScript physics bugs into the specification oracle (single-push collapse, rule-order swap, Bard Manhattan/post-move bugs, non-weighing walls, Wizard adjacent swap, inactive Priest heal, sequential Goblin kill, hero-cycle swap, missing Cancel) and verify 10/10 detection.

extra_vectors.description: Optional additional regression test vectors to include in the mutation audit.
